levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the five required capstone components is missing from the presentation.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All five components are presented in a coherent order that a listener could follow easily.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Named gaps are vague or minimizing, with no specific skill or evidence named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names at least two specific gaps tied to a specific skill.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names two specific gaps, each backed by a specific piece of evidence from the year's actual work.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection names a skill with no supporting evidence from the learner's own work.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names a specific skill with a plausible piece of supporting evidence.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names a specific skill with concrete evidence drawn from an identifiable earlier lesson this year.

lookFors: The two named gaps are genuinely different from each other and specific, not both variations of 'nervousness.'
The guardian's summarized response in t3 reflects an actual two-way conversation, not a one-line 'good job.'
The year-end reflection cites something concrete and specific, not a generic 'I learned a lot this year.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
